column1: # TITLE: The effect of HO-1 overexpression on microRNA transcriptome in NCI-H292 lung cancer cells

# SUMMARY: The aim was to determine the effect of heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) overexpression on microRNA transcriptome in human non-small cell lung carcinoma cell line (NCI-H292). Since the cells of different HO-1 genotypes were used (cells are after retroviral transduction with empty vector with normal level of HO-1 or retroviral transduction with vector harboring HO-1)
column2: it is possible get the comprehensive answer which microRNAs are regulated by HO-1.
